yahoo.title: S&P 500
yahoo.value_rule: adjclose if present, otherwise close; last daily value per month

ex_ante_feasibility.calibration: chapter-8 teaching distribution, not market data

limitations: Yahoo is price return; Shiller is total return with dividends.
Pre-1957 Shiller index history is reconstructed.
Only the preregistered 12-month volatility rule is tested.

parameters.scale_reference: expanding arithmetic mean of trailing-12m vol

shiller.response: nominal total return (real TR price * CPI)

vintage_statement: Prices are not retrospectively revised; this task therefore does not earn vintage-data rigor for later macro work.
